text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A crucial race to gauge the autumn GⅠ 
campaign. The day of the GⅡ 'Kyoto 
Daishoten' had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With both Senior Class heavyweights and 
brilliant Classic Class talents gathered, 
the venue is packed with fervent 
excitement—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oh... Here it comes, it's finally time...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Good day. My name is Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today, I intend to do my utmost so that 
all of you may witness the brilliance of a 
diamond.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oho, she really has an aura about her...! 
As expected of the jewel of the Satono 
Group...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
She's got serious skills, too! Man, I 
can't help but expect great things...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH--!! Do your best, Satono 
Diamond--!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(These cheers... That must be Dia-san. She 
really is... an amazing, formidable 
runner.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, ...yeah. It's okay. ...It should 
be fine.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Because... I worked hard this summer. 
...Together with Big Sis and Vivlos, a 
lot.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(So... I'll lift my head up and run. I'll 
take today's race and turn it into 
strength.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(To run the absolute best race... at the 
Japan Cup...!)
